podcast.body: As the second of six singles from "The Suburbs," this song was accompanied by an innovative interactive video designed by Chris Milk using HTML5. The video integrated Google Maps and Google Street View, developed with assistance from Chrome browser coders, allowing users to experience it by entering their street address at thewildernessdowntown.com. For the vinyl version of "The Suburbs," the tone arm must be removed after this song finishes side 3 to prevent an infinite loop of sound. "The song used from the project was this one. The second of six singles from the suburbs. It's we used to wait."
